description: This PHP file defines the class CachingStream which implements a stream decorator that adds caching functionality to a PSR-7 StreamInterface object. It includes methods for stream manipulation such as getSize, rewind, seek, read, write, eof, and close, with an internal mechanism to cache and efficiently handle stream data, especially for sequential reading scenarios.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A final class that decorates a stream with caching behavior, allowing for efficient re-reads of streamed data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CachingStream instance with the given stream and an optional target cache stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known, considering both the remote stream and the cache.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the stream based on the offset and whence.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, caching remote data as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the cache stream, updating skip bytes logic for overwriting scenarios.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of both the cache and remote stream has been reached.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote stream and the cache stream.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire remote stream into a target stream.
